verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CIPO publishes downloadable bulk data sets (IP Horizons). That is a bulk data export, not a documented way to act on many items at once, such as batch filing, renewing, amending or paying fees across multiple trademarks or patents. The online services shown (apply/amend, renew, MyCIPO Patents) have no documented batch or multi-item mode, so the support is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
